about_the_game:
Launch zombies sky-high. Defend the trenches. Protect the bunker.

BunkerZ is a uniquely stylized third-person zombie shooter set in WWI. Trapped behind enemy lines, you and your squad must fortify a crumbling bunker and survive relentless waves of the undead. Work together, build defenses, and blast zombies into the air with tactical explosions.

Key Features:

  • Wave-Based Survival
    Face off against increasingly deadly zombie hordes with unforgiving battles.

  • World War I Arsenal
    Fight with historically inspired weapons. Use era specific bolt-action rifles, trench guns, bayonets, shovels, flamethrowers, and early prototypes of automatic weapons.

  • Character Classes
    Play as specialized roles like the Rifleman, Engineer, Medic, or Machine Gunner. Each class uses unique loadouts and team utilities.

  • Build & Defend
    Place mines, construct barricades, and upgrade your defenses as you fight to survive.

  • Co-op Multiplayer
    Squad up with friends or brave the bunker solo.

  • Stylized Visuals
    A unique aesthetic that fuses World War I trench warfare with stylized characters and over-the-top zombie-slinging chaos.

  • Evolving Enemy Types
    From shambling infantry to grotesque brutes and rifle-wielding undead soldiers, every wave brings new threats.

content_descriptors.notes:
BunkerZ features stylized violence, blood effects, and zombie ragdoll in a stylized/cartoonish setting.
Players use WWI-inspired weapons to defend bunkers against waves of undead enemies.
While there is no realistic gore or body part dismemberment, enemies will explode or ragdoll from grenades and explosives.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or intel i7-9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or NVIDIA RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

short_description: Stylized WWI trenches meet explosive co-op mayhem. Hold the bunker as a Rifleman, Medic, Engineer, or Machine Gunner. Fight back with era specific WWI weapons, shovels, and flamethrowers, then launch undead sky-high with grenades and explosives. Solo or multiplayer survival at its most chaotic.
